steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Apply the first offered RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER product specified by the case.
Enter the requested quantity for the product.
Search for and add the named vendor even though it is not mapped to the product.
Verify that the unmapped vendor was added and is visible in the participant area.
